build_transform_gen_3d: build 3D transform generators for image augmentation with resizing and flipping from config
build_transform_gen: build 2D transform generators for image augmentation including resizing and cropping from config
convert_coco_poly_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentations to binary masks as tensors given height and width
load_depth_and_camera_parameters: load depth images and camera parameters from files and compute multi-scale 3D point coordinates
create_dataset_mapper: create a COCOInstanceNewBaselineDatasetMapper instance from config for training or inference
